jobs.description_text: At Lendbuzz, we believe financial opportunity should be more personalized and fair. jobs.location_raw: Arlington, Virginia · Clifton Park, New York
jobs.description_text: Team Description: Kitware'scomputer vision team is a leader in the creation of cutting-edge algorithms and software for automated image and video analysis. Our solutions embrace deep learning and add measurable value to government agencies, commercial organizations, and academic institutions worldwide. We understand the difficulties in extracting, interpreting, and utilizing information across images, video, metadata, and text, and we recognize the need for robust, affordable solutions. We seek to advance the fields of computer vision and deep learning through research and development and through collaborative projects that build on our open source software platforms, such as VIAMEand Telesculptor. About the Projects: By joining our team, you will be contributing your software development expertise in the areas of computer vision and/or machine learning to develop robust solutions for real-world problems. Our projects focus on areas such as 3D reconstruction, object detection, image manipulation detection, and motion pattern learning and anomaly detection. Kitware’s employees have unique opportunities to interact and collaborate directly with customers, visit interesting customer sites, and participate in live field tests and demonstrations. Research and Development Engineers at Kitware also have the opportunity to publish and maintain open source software packages.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description_text: Join the Future of Robotic Biomanufacturing! Multiply Labs is a robotics company on a mission to solve a significant bottleneck in modern medicine: the manufacturing of life-saving advanced biologics, from gene and cell therapies to antibodies and more. Today, these therapies are produced through manual, labor-intensive processes. Costs are extremely high—often $500K–$2M per patient—limiting access to only a small fraction of those who need them. As product complexity increases and the cost of failure and scientific labor rises, the industry is shifting toward automation. Robotics and AI are making automated biologics manufacturing feasible, reliable, and economically scalable. We believe the future of biomanufacturing is robotic—closed, automated, and scalable—ensuring critical therapeutics are accessible to every patient who needs them. Why This Matters We don’t just build robots—we’re building the essential infrastructure for next generation biologics. Our technology enables biopharma companies to scale production without redesigning their science, reducing regulatory hurdles and lowering costs so these treatments can reach more patients. The Stack & The Scale The Mission: Build the world’s best robots to make life-saving therapies accessible to all. The Technology: Advanced robotic orchestration, high-precision automation, cloud-integrated hardware-software systems, dextrous manipulation, and imitation learning. The Location: Headquartered in San Francisco, CA. The Backin

jobs.description_text: NextGen Federal Systems is seeking a detail-oriented Mid-Level Data Labeling Specialist to support Artificial Intelligence Operations (AIOPS) initiatives within the Next Generation Command and Control (NGC2) environment. This role will focus on preparing, annotating, categorizing, and validating structured and unstructured data for use within existing AI platforms and operational applications. AIOPS supports the operational adoption and use of AI-enabled capabilities across NGC2. Accurate, consistently organized, and traceable data helps ensure these existing platforms can effectively support operational workflows and user requirements. The ideal candidate will have practical experience in data annotation, data quality assurance, and dataset organization, with the ability to apply defined labeling standards independently. This role requires collaboration with technical personnel, functional subject matter experts, and government stakeholders to clarify data requirements and resolve quality issues.

jobs.title: Senior Validation Engineer : 2G/4G/5G Radio Products
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Validation engineer for the Regression team validating 2G, 4G and 5G (including O-RAN) radio products. You will turn the product roadmap into automated test scenarios and make sure radio products meet quality, conformance and schedule commitments. Key Responsibilities Automation Build and maintain Python automation frameworks (Pytest/Unittest), including instrument drivers and measurement applications (Python, MATLAB). Automate Radio Conformance Test (RCT) and E2E scenarios, integrated with CI/CD and Kubernetes-based execution. Apply AI/ML to test generation, log analysis, failure triage and anomaly detection. RF Validation and Debug Execute 3GPP RCT and characterize RF subsystems (PA, LNA, filters, CFR, DPD) using Keysight or R&S equipment. Develop measurement workflows for EVM, ACLR, sensitivity, noise figure, spectral emissions and linearity. Root-cause RF issues with hardware, firmware and software teams, drive silicon bring-up, and give design teams actionable recommendations.

jobs.title: Sr. Tech Lead, Prod Dev (RAN, AI-Assisted RCA, Design & Development)
jobs.description_text: Parallel Wireless is transforming its Feature-Validation & Stability organization into a single Prod-Dev team — in the AI era there is no longer a separate "development" vs "validation" team. We are building a group of strong System Engineers who own a problem end to end: understand the complete product behavior, find the actual root cause, and contribute directly to the fix — accelerated by Claude / AI-assisted engineering. This is a pro-development, system-level problem-solving role. You will take a field or test issue and drive it the whole way: Issue → Reproduction → Cross-layer analysis → RCA → Code investigation → Fix → Validation You will not stop at "which component failed." You will name the root cause, prove it, and fix it.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Data Platform
jobs.description_text: Every dataset at Spotify, from the data behind creator royalties to the signals powering recommendations, is registered, published and traced through systems our team builds. We're the source of truth for what data exists at Spotify, where it lives, who owns it, and how it flows from one pipeline to the next. These systems sit on the critical path of the platform. Data teams use them every day to publish and find data, and other platform teams build on them for access, retention, governance and incident response. That means our work is judged on correctness and reliability, because every system built on top of ours is only as good as the metadata we provide. This is a backend role focused on data management, working on the problems at the core of any large data platform: running a data catalog that stays accurate at scale, capturing lineage across batch and streaming workloads, managing schemas as they evolve, and guaranteeing that consumers only read complete data. We build on open standards like OpenLineage and Apache Iceberg, and define the internal standards for naming, storage and metadata that the rest of Spotify builds against. As the platform takes on new storage technologies and new kinds of data assets, those standards and the systems behind them have to evolve with it, and you'll help decide how.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Data Platform
jobs.description_text: LilEngine is leading the Lakehouse, a company-strategic effort to make Apache Iceberg a first-class citizen in Spotify's data ecosystem. We're building it in close collaboration with Google, on open standards, so that different kinds of data are queryable the same way and teams can bring the right engine, from BigQuery to Dataflow to Trino, to the job. The work has two parts. Hecate enables Iceberg for the Parquet datasets that already exist across Spotify, so teams get the benefits without rewriting their data. Alongside it, we're building the foundations of a new Lakehouse architecture that lets workflows write Iceberg tables natively. We're shipping the MVP this cycle, and you'll help shape what comes next. We also own BigQuery for all of Spotify. Thousands of engineers, data scientists and pipelines depend on it every day, which puts us on the critical path for storing, finding and querying data. We're judged on reliability, cost efficiency and how quickly we unblock users when something breaks. This backend role sits where open table formats, cloud data warehouses and processing engines meet.

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer Position for Xsolla's Smart Wallet in Web3
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer who has tested real on-chain products — the contracts and the transactions, not only the web app in front of them. You will own quality for Xsolla's smart wallet on Xsolla ZK , our Ethereum-compatible ZK rollup: the wallet players use to hold, receive and send tokens and in-game items, signing in with the account they already have. The work runs on both sides of the chain. On the backend, you will confirm that a wallet address pre-computed from a salt is the address that actually gets deployed. On the frontend, you will follow a signed operation from the client's RPC call through the bundler to finality, and prove it landed, failed or reverted the way it should. You will fork the chain to test against real state, deploy and call contracts from the command line, and turn what you learn into automated suites. You will work in a small, senior engineering team alongside an external wallet-infrastructure partner. You can tell a defect in our code from one in a partner SDK or in the chain itself — and you bring the evidence to show which. AI coding tools are part of how you work every day, and you set them up so the rest of the team gets the same leverage.

Bij ITIS Products in Barendrecht krijg je alle ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen tot succesvol softwareaccountmanager. Je richt je voornamelijk op new business , leert alles over onze innovatieve softwareoplossingen en bouwt stap voor stap aan jouw eigen klantenportefeuille. Ervaring met softwareverkoop is mooi meegenomen, maar jouw commerciële drive en enthousiasme zijn voor ons veel belangrijker. Wat ga je doen? Als Junior Accountmanager Software ligt jouw focus op het creëren van nieuwe commerciële kansen. Je gaat actief op zoek naar potentiële klanten, legt de eerste contacten en laat organisaties kennismaken met de softwareoplossingen van ITIS Products. Je krijgt hierbij de begeleiding van ervaren collega's, zodat je jezelf kunt ontwikkelen tot een zelfstandig accountmanager. Je adviseert organisaties over SOFOS 360 , onze software voor het registreren en beheren van gevaarlijke stoffen. Daarnaast werk je met Chemwatch , een internationaal toonaangevende softwareoplossing waarvoor ITIS Products exclusief partner is binnen de Benelux. Jouw werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Actief benaderen van nieuwe klanten en genereren van new business. Opbouwen van jouw eigen klantenportefeuille. Plannen van commerciële afspraken bij potentiële klanten. Inventariseren van klantbehoeften en commerciële kansen. Verzorgen van softwaredemonstraties, zelfstandig of samen

jobs.title: Senior ML Engineer
jobs.description_text: For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands. About SkinVision Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped over 3 million people worldwide. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin cancer images and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. Where needed, cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need. jobs.title: Senior netwerk infrastructuur engineer
jobs.description_text: Wil jij, met inzet van moderne technieken, zorg dragen voor het fysieke en virtuele netwerk van het CBS en hiermee de beschikbaarheid en betrouwbaarheid maximaliseren? Heb je daarnaast affiniteit met het automatiseren van beheer en hersteltaken? Dan biedt het CBS jou een unieke kans! Waar jij het verschil maakt Je levert en ontwikkelt diensten op basis van virtuele netwerktechnieken en beheert en onderhoudt deze; Je zorgt voor de continuïteit van het CBS door het fysieke netwerk te onderhouden, te ontwikkelen en te beheren, zowel in het datacenter als op kantoorlocaties. Je werkt aan de bescherming van onze omgeving middels beheer van firewalls, microsegmentatie, proxy servers en application delivery controllers; Je werkt aan het maximaal automatiseren van beheertaken en het bieden van autonomie aan afnemende teams Je hebt affiniteit met het aanbieden van infrastructuurdiensten als selfservice en door middel van ‘Infrastructure-as-Code’. Je toekomstige collega's Je werkt in het Team IaaS van de afdeling Generieke Infrastructuur (IGI). We opereren middels een Agile methodiek, in combinatie met ITIL. Een actieve bijdrage wordt verwacht in het succes van deze werkmethode, dit uit zich oa in het opstellen van kwalitatief goede story’s en Epics, het actueel houden van jouw story’s op het Azure DevOps bord, actieve en constructieve deelname aan events als dag-starts, planning, review en retrospectives. De totale omvang van de afdeling Generieke Infrastructuur is ongeveer 30 experts
